column3: Description

Converts wildmen in the radius into Braves of your tribe.
Insects make enemy followers flee in panic; they abandon preaching, boats, and balloons.
Followers turn invisible until they start fighting.
Shields followers from direct spells and boosts them in battle.
Raises a land bridge from the Shaman to the target point.
Powerful strike that kills unshielded followers, flings nearby ones, and ignites buildings.
Enemy followers in the radius fight for you for about 15 seconds.
Roams randomly, hurling followers and sucking up buildings.
Followers entering it die. Disappears after 10 kills.
Levels the land around the target to the target height.
Splits the ground with lava; low shoreline land sinks briefly.
Quickly sinks the land; low land floods with buildings and people on it.
Flaming meteors ignite everyone (not your Shaman) and wreck buildings in a large radius.
Summons a flyer that seizes and kills enemy followers, shielded or not. Lives about 5 minutes.
Raises a volcano that burns buildings and followers and spreads lava and land.
Super spell. Raises an arena and teleports every follower in the world into one battle.
Super spell. Instantly teleports the Shaman anywhere on the map.
